# Start Building Now

> AI-guided discovery and validation for aspiring builders. Find what to build based on your unique talents, experience, and networks — then sharpen your idea until it's unbeatable.

## About
Start Building Now helps people who want to build something but don't know where to start. Using AI-guided conversations, we help you discover and validate business ideas that are uniquely yours.

## How It Works

### Explore Phase — Find What to Build
We dig into what makes you you — your talents, your life experience, your connections — to uncover a space that feels like it was made for you.

### Evaluate Phase — Sharpen Your Idea
Together we develop and score your idea, looking for deep-rooted human problems, challenges, and emotional opportunities to help you build the absolute best idea that only you can deliver.

- [Home](https://www.whattobuild.app/)

## Details
- Built for first-time builders, career changers, and aspiring entrepreneurs
- AI-powered conversational discovery process
- Idea scoring and validation against real human needs
- Research into market gaps, competition, and opportunity spaces
